title: Weak Cosmic Censorship for Vacuum Spacetimes
exact_target: For generic regular isolated-system data, decide whether gravitational singularities are always hidden from distant observers.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004804 (OWR-8415343-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/40, pp. 2157--2267. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The source gives a weak-cosmic-censorship programme. A choice of topology for genericity and a precise conformal-completion and singularity criterion is needed for a theorem; no such extra choice is imposed here.
